description: This script rewrites GitHub wiki URLs in a file to local markdown references, decoding special characters and adding a marker to prevent reprocessing.

methods.name: rewrite_wiki_links
methods.description: Rewrites wiki URLs in the specified file to local markdown links, decoding percent-encoded characters, and creates a marker file to prevent reprocessing.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Iterates over command-line arguments (file paths) and applies URL rewriting.
